name: Syarikat Takaful Malaysia Keluarga Berhad
overview: 2026年公司公告主要涉及股东授权更新、公司章程修订及治理委员会人事变动，未披露具体业务板块的扩张、缩减或新合约。最新季度营收同比增长16.2%，净利润同比增长6.0%。
overview_en: In 2026, the company's announcements mainly covered renewal of shareholders' mandate, amendments to the constitution, and changes in board committees; no specific business segment expansion, reduction, or new contracts were disclosed. Latest quarterly revenue grew 16.2% year-on-year and net profit grew 6.0% year-on-year.
